guidance.text: Write the system as Markdown tables a person could scan. THINGS: columns name | kind | what it does. VALUES: columns thing | quantity | value | unit | when. LINKS: columns from | relation | to | condition. EVENTS: columns when | what happens | effect. RULES: one bullet per rule, written 'if <condition> then <consequence>'. UNKNOWNS: one bullet per thing the description leaves open. Use the exact names, numbers and units from the description; never invent a value.

name: MARKDOWN
notes: checked Markdown: tables for things, values, links, events; rule bullets (human, run 5)
